owner_calls.question: Deadpool 2's mid-credits jump to Stryker's Three Mile Island facility: should this entry stay on the Earth-41578 map, or move to an Earth-10005 Three Mile Island, since the brief puts the Deadpool films on Earth-10005?
options: Keep on Earth-41578 (fox), with the Origins facility it targets
Move to a new Three Mile Island place on Earth-10005 (foxtrn), since this is Wade going back into his own world's past
owner_calls.evidence: In the Deadpool 2 mid-credits scene, Wade uses Cable's repaired device to go back to the 1979 Three Mile Island facility from X-Men Origins: Wolverine and shoots Weapon XI. The film uses archive footage from Origins. The facility is the one from Origins, but the rules put Deadpool's world on Earth-10005. No source says which timeline's past Wade visits.
